'''Koki Kofuns''' (小木古墳群, ''Koki Kofungun'') are a group of [[kofun]] (ancient Kofuns) from the [[Kofun period]] located in the Koki district in the western part of {{ill|Komaki|en|Komaki|qid=Q389537|lt=Komaki}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture}}. Although no formal archaeological survey has been conducted, the artifacts unearthed suggest they date to the late {{ill|3rd century|en|3rd century|qid=Q8101|lt=3rd century}} to the {{ill|4th century|af|4de eeu|als|4.
